<function=python>
<parameter=code>
for i in range(3):
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':25,'col':61}])
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    py=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='Y']
    plug=min(py,key=lambda n:n['pixels'])
    pb=[p for p in plug['boundary']]; 
    print(i, "score",res['score'],"done",res['done'],"lvlcomp",res['level_completed'],
          "plug_cols",min(p[1] for p in pb),max(p[1] for p in pb),
          "playerY_cols",max(p[1] for p in [q for q in py if q is not plug][0]['boundary']))
    if res['done'] or res['level_completed']: break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
